newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end down after five-day rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end down after five-day rally.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market"s key index saw its five-day rally end on Tuesday as global blue-chips lost their shine with investors after recent heavy gains, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 average fell 279.90 points or 1.49 percent to the day"s low of 18,470.75.
Its March futures shed 220 points to end at 18,500.
